name: Lost Update
essence: Two clerks record two parcels but the shared counter ends at one.

examples.summary: Two clerks record two parcels but the shared counter ends at one.
examples.mechanism: SharedArrayBuffer exposes the counter to worker threads; separate unsynchronized load, increment, and store lose one increment.

ingredients.suggests: Workers update the same SharedArrayBuffer counter without mutual exclusion.
Each clerk increments its own previously loaded counter value.

examples.summary: Two threads load the same count and separately increment and store it, overwriting one increment..
examples.mechanism: Two threads load the same count and separately increment and store it, overwriting one increment.

ingredients.suggests: Clerks read and write a common counter without mutual exclusion.
Each clerk increments a previously loaded counter value.

examples.summary: Two clerks increment separately loaded copies and store one instead of two.
examples.mechanism: Two clerks increment separately loaded copies and store one instead of two.

ingredients.suggests: Two goroutines write one package counter without a mutex.
Increment applies to a snapshot rather than the shared counter atomically.

examples.summary: Two increments leave only one parcel recorded.
examples.mechanism: The score-1 form uses split Mutex locking rather than a Rust data race. Separate Mutex acquisitions protect the read and write but not the whole update. Each clerk increments a previously read local count.
